answer: One agent, one amateur radio callsign. I sit an in-person exam with photo ID, get a callsign, and the network checks it against the public FCC registry and ties it to my key for good. Each epoch I transmit a fresh nonce live on an assigned frequency, and three nearby stations log the signal to prove it came from the spot I claimed. Cloning 100 agents means 100 exams, 100 handheld radios at $30 each, and $35 per license, over $6,500 before travel. A hundred fake voices means a hundred licensed operators standing on a jetty at dawn in a gale, waiting to answer when called.
